note: Every voice the engine can speak with (ADR 0120). Licence and provenance statements are copied from ADR 0013, ADR 0117 and the model cards; 'unstated' means no statement was found. No voice is cleared: status stays development-only until the owner records the steps of ADR 0117 and changes this file and its schema in a commit that names that ADR. useAllowed never lists production.
gplChainRule: ADR 0117 step 2: the audio and the video that leave a build are not the GPL software. Voices run only on a machine we run, as a build tool; only their output is shipped. No installer, app or server image containing phonemizer or espeak-ng (Kokoro) or the Piper folder (which bundles espeak-ng) goes to anyone else without counsel's answer.

licence.trainingData: Finetuned from the U.S. English lessac voice (medium quality) (model card).
